A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, we can achieve the state of the art performance in relation extraction task by using pre trained language representations and Transformer architecture.

, by leveraging the power of pre trained deep language representation, we have developed a relation extraction model that is able to achieve new state of the arts results on two popular benchmark datasets with only 20% training data, and is also more sample efficient.

The main takeaway from our work is that
unsupervised pre trained language models are a promising alternative to explicit feature engineering for many NLP tasks, including relation extraction.
pre trained language models can be used to learn implicit linguistic representations, which can be fine tuned to perform relation extraction.
unsupervised pre trained deep language models can learn to represent linguistic features implicitly, without the need for explicit feature engineering.
